origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
Lmektub n wemdan yeldin ugar n waṭas nniḍen - kker ɣer sdat war ayen yelhan neɣ ayen n diri.
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Alfiq
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Abuzun ur nemɛin ara§r
§o§2+ Amussu asuf§r
§o§6• Amseččay§r
§o§c- Ammesten§r
§lAlfiq§r D yiwet n telmest n yimcac i d-yettbinen s wudem umdan, s waccaren iqeṛḥen, s uḥerrek igerrzen. Iberdan-nsen zgan ttawin ɣer yijdi yeḥman.
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Aṛaknay
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Ssem, asefrek n lɣaci
+ Aterras n lḥiḍ§r
§o§6• Amseččay§r
§o§c- Laẓ, Armor§r
Asdukkel n tissist d umdan, s tuɣmas n ssem, s iḍarren n uqeṛṛu, yerna yezmer ad yelḥu yernu ad yeddu s yiɣallen..
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Banci
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Afeggag, tallelt, asfari§r
§o§6• Undead
§o§c- Ammesten§r
§o§c- Ibeddilen imeqranen, ɣeṛ qbel!§r
§lBanshees§r D leṛwaḥ n lmeḥna, imeṭṭawen-nsen zemren ad rẓen lxiḍ, ad d-awin imdanen ɣer tderwect. Deg umezruy, tilin-nsen tettwaḥsab d tafat n lmut..
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: Incubus
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Ibunusen n ddaw
§o§6• Yeddukel ɣef Fire
§o§c- Yettwaɣ s waman§r
§o§c- D arurmid deg Overworld§r
§lIncubi§r d iqeddacen n kra n tezmert n ṭṭlam. Sɛan tazmert deg tgelda-nsen, maca deg umḍiq n waya, fkan-d iman-nsen, yerna ur zmiren ara i yiɣbula izedganen..
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Ajenniw
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Timẓin, tiɣbula§r
§o§6• Wezzil: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- Yettḥulfu i yiṭij 
- Ur yezmir ara ad iɛumm§r
§lIɣerdayen§r d imseqdacen, d imqebbalen, d wid yettzuxxun s yiman-nsen. Zgan deg lmina d tudert ddaw wakal, maca ttnaɣen d tafat n wass. Aẓru d uẓru, a gma..
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Aɣelluy n Teẓgi
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Ibunusen yettwafernen, arured§r
§o§6• S tuffra, d imɣan§r
§o§c- Ammesten§r
§lWood Elves§r D tawsit tamusni, ɣezzifen deg tudert i yettidiren deg umtawa akked Lqaεa. D arurad s ujenwi d uẓeṭṭa, zemren ad zwiren iɛdawen-nsen mi ara ilin gar yisekla..
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: Aḥeddad Ameqran
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Taḥerci, tizemmar tusligin§r
§o§c- Aɣelluy n tfekka
- Ammesten§r
§lHigh Elves§r d wid yettwasnen s zzux, ɣas akken ur d-yettban ara belli sɛan kra n uẓwir; taẓuri n yiferdisen tettili-d s tezmert tameqqrant deg idammen-nsen, ɣas akken ur zmiren ara s yimrigen.
origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: Fae
origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Asekḥer, usekḥer§r
§o§6• Wezzil: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- Iḥemmel-it ugdud§r
§lFae§r D iɣersiwen n teẓgi n tẓuri, yeččuren d ssḥur n ugama, yeqqnen mliḥ ɣer teẓgi seg wanda i d-kkan..
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Goblin
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Ibunusen n Gold Gear§r
§o§2+ Zzher, arured§r 
§o§6• Amecṭuḥ: 92cm.3'3"§r 
§o§c- Tazmert, Taɣellist§r
§lIɣublin§r ttḥezziben ɣef wureɣ d agerruj, ttafen-d cwiṭ n lfayda anda bɣan, maca meẓẓiyit maḍi, dɣa ur ten-yettaǧǧa ara yiwen deg umennuɣ..
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Gurgun
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Asenɣes n usemmiḍ, taẓeyt§r
§o§2+ Asenqed n ugraw§r
§o§c- Aḥemmal n waman 
- Tiwtilin n leǧruḥ§r
§lGorgons§r D iɣersiwen yettwaɛeggen i yellan zik d imdanen, s ucebbub n uzrem yettḥerriken, s wudem yessexlaɛen, qqaren-d yessexlaɛen wid i tt-yettwalin..
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Alf n wayyur
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Aɣelluy n lmus
+ Dxtrous§r
§o§6• S tuffra, ur yeggan ara§r
§o§c- Ammesten§r
Imdanen-a ur nelli d wid n ddunit-a. Ilfuyen n wayyur ur sɛin ara isem-nsen ɣef tmurt-nsen, maca ɣef wayen kan i zemren ad t-walin wid i ten-yettwaɣen uqbel tamettant-nsen.
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Ugr
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Axe Bonuses, Ammesten §r
§o§6• Meqqer: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Laẓ, arured §r
§lUgren§r d yiwen n tewsit tameqqrant, d tamezzangut, d taḥerfit n Orc. Teɣzi-nsen tameqqrant d tzemni-nsen i yesεan tilas, d ayen i ten-id-yeǧǧan s tezmert-nsen tameqqrant.
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Pixie
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Afeggag asuf, asuf§r
§o§6• Amecṭuḥ: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Ammesten, Isem §r
Zgan ttwaḥsaben d imeskaren n ẓẓher, maca daɣen d imeskaren n cceṛ, ur nettwaman ara. Tipixiyin d tiḥerfiyin yerna meẓẓiyit aṭas.
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Yeqqur §r
§o§6• Aɣanib n tɣuri asuf §r
§o§6• Undead §r
§o§c- Ammesten, Isem 
§o§c- Yewɛer§r
Iɣewwaṛen n waṭṭan, d wid ur nezmir ad ten-id-neḥseb d imdanen, d wid yettwaḥeṛṛcen yerna ttwaṭṭfen deg lmeḥna n lebda ɣef lǧal n waṭṭan-nni n ssḥur..
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Tuzzna §r
§o§2+ Illager Friendly 
§o§6• Undead, Complex §r
§o§c- Tamusni
- Imyigewlen udmawanen §r
§lInekcam§r D tirwiḥin ur nesεi ẓẓher i yemmuten s lmeḥna d lmeḥna, maca uɣalen-d ɣer tudert akken ur d-nban. D ayen i ten-yeǧǧan ttḥezziben ɣef tudert d lmut n yiɣersiwen-nniḍen..
origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: Siren
origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Yettwabna ɣef waman, tanfa §r
§o§6• D afessas deg wakal§r
§o§c- Yewḥel i tmes§r
§lTisirinin§r Qqaren-d d yiwen n ṣṣenf n Merfolk. Sɛan tafrara i d-yettawin, yerna ccbaḥa-nsen ur nettwaqbal, qqaren-d d tin i d-yeǧǧan aṭas n yimerrawen d ungifen..
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: Yiti
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Yettwabna ɣef wedfel, Tanky§r
§o§6• Meqqer: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- Yettḥulfu i uzɣal§r
Iɣersiwen n tqecwalt i d-yekkan seg teẓgi yeqquren d agris, tageldit n Yeti ɣef wegris tettaǧǧa-t ad yegres iɛdawen-is, maca d wid i d-yettwaɣen s wudem ameqqran s tmes..
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nAgzul§r: 
§o§2+ Aḥellu§r 
§o§6• Iferrawen n yiferrawen§r 
§o§c- D awezɣi ɣer Undead§r
§lValkyrie§r D irgazen ur nettkukru, i d-yettaṭṭafen rray n wid yettnaɣen deg umennuɣ; qqaren-d wwin wid yemmuten ɣer Walhalla n Odin.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Yettwaḥreṣ
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Alfiq ɣur-s ijerriḍen i izemren ad d-yeqqen s uḥeǧǧaǧ; ttḍurrun ugar s ifassen-nsen d ilmawen, yerna zemren ad alin u ad ṭṭfen deg tqacuct n tqacuct (izmer ad yettwabeddel)
Mi ara d-yeɣli yiṭij neɣ mi ara d-yecreq, Alfiq ad imerreḥ yerna ad d-iwet s tɣawla ugar. Tikwal nniḍen, ad ten-teǧǧ tafat yerna ad rnun cwiṭ s leɛqel.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: Ma yella, mi ara d-terseḍ, tettmuquleḍ srid d akessar, ur k-yettḍurru ara uɣelluy.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Tekki s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef uɛrur n yiwen n umdan n taddart mi ara yeqqen s yifarasen d ilmawen akken ad d-takreḍ kra n usmiragd. Neɣ ad k-id-ṭṭfen. Yettban-d d akken tzemreḍ ad d-takreḍ seg yimurar nniḍen.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Pounce
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: Seld ad yeẓẓel cwiṭ war ma yerra iman-is akken ad d-yernu, Alfiq yezmer ad ineggez ɣer sdat s waṭas. Ma yewwet yiwen aɛdaw mi ara yeẓẓel, ad t-ijerreḥ.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Alfiq ssneqsen tazzla n rrẓi s yifecka, ssneqsen lmeḥna s yimrigen n ufus am yijenwiyen d temẓin.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Alfiq yesmenyif ad yelsi kan iserdasen fessusen akken ad yessifsus uḥerrek-is. Iserdasen ẓẓayen zemren ad tt-lsen war ad ten-iḥasef yiwen.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Myaw
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Arachnae ḥwaǧen aṭas n wučči akken ad idiren.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: Aɣelluy n yiɣewwaṛen n Arachnae yettarra-t yewɛer i uḥerrek ma yella ttlusuyen arurad ẓẓayen ɣef wuzzal. Aya yezmer ad yettwaseḥbes s kra n usḥerci.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: Tifeṭṭiǧin-nni timecṭuḥin n yiqejjiren n Arachnae ttaǧǧant-ten ad alin ɣer lḥiḍ.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: Aɣelluy n Arachnae d win yettwaḥerren ugar. Sɛan cwiṭ n tdawsa drus maḍi ɣef umdan amagnu.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Tmanya-nni n wallen n Arachnae nnumen akk d tillas, yerna ttaǧǧan-ten ad walin akken iwata xas ma drus mliḥ tafat.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Iɣil n uṛaknay deg-s ssem, yerna yal azbu yezmer ad d-yeglu s ssem.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Ibanciyen sɛan tazmert ad uɣalen d wid ur nettwaṭṭaf, ttazzalen s tlelli deg umaḍal n tfekka ɣas akken ur zmiren ara ad mmeslayen yid-s. Ayagi yesseqdac aṭas n tezmert, ur yezmir ara ad yettwasermed ticki lluẓen.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Yettwaḥeccem
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Ibanṣiyen ttwaɣalen-d s lxiḍ. Yal mi ara ten-wten, yezmer lḥal ad yili win i ten-yewten ad yemmet s leɛqel, s leqriḥ.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: Ibanciyen sɛan azgen seg tezmert n umdan yeddren.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Iɣuda yettḥerriken s tẓuri, am wuzzal neɣ lfeṭṭa, ur ten-ttḥamaɛen ara akk yibanciyen.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Ibanciyen ur d-ttawin ara laẓ s wučči - tazmert-nsen tettwarra-d kan s tafat n wayyur srid, maca ur zmiren ara ad mmten s laẓ.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Tiɣriwin n banshee ttɛeggint ɣef tmettant. Zemrent ad d-ssuffɣent yiwen n uɣeẓẓan i d-yettaǧǧan imeẓẓuɣen-nsent, ad d-ssufɣent tiɣawsiwin i d-yezzin ɣer tama-nsent, ad d-ssiwlen tawinest tamecṭuḥt n ummesten. Iswiyen i d-yewwet srid uɣeẓẓan ad ten-yexṣer
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: Tettḍurruḍ ugar mi ara tesqedceḍ amrig n lbaṭel.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Tettaṭṭafeḍ ayen ara k-iṛuḥen deg yal aḥric n tṛekkazt-nni n lbaṭel.
Aẓeṭṭa ur yeffiɣ. Ma mačči d aksum n uɣersiw, ur yesɛi ara azal.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: Incubi d wid iǧehden akk s tẓuri n tmes, yerna zemren ad d-ssuffɣen times akken i sen-yehwa. Tifesniwin s tezmert n temseḥḥert n tmes.
Times tettḥulfu-d am uxxam-is - ur d-tettḍurru acemma i Incubi yerna tesseččay-iten.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Aman sserɣayen Incubi, ttḍurrun mi ara ten-id-yennal.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Incubi ttawin-d uguren-nniḍen seg Smite akked yigmaḍ-nniḍen i d-yettuɣalen seg useḥlu d weḍru.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Incubi ur uɣen ara tannumi d tfesniwin anda i d-yettfeǧǧiǧ yiṭij, dɣa din ur zmiren ara, maca deg Nether i iǧehden s waṭas.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: An incubus yezmer ad isemselsi kra seg yiɣil-is n tudert s raw power i kra n wakud wezzilen. Yettwasekker s tsarut Primary Active.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: Tafat n yiṭij srid ad tesserɣ allen n yiqeffawen, ad ten-tesderɣel i kra n wakud. Tzemreḍ ad ten-tḥebseḍ s usḥerci neɣ s uṣelmun n wureɣ.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: Ẓẓay
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: Iɣerdayen ẓẓayen nezzeh ɣef teɣzi-nsen ; ttenɣaben s tɣawla deg waman.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Iɣerdayen zemren ad d-kksen aẓru mebla aqeṛṛu, yerna ad d-kksen kullec s tɣawla ugar n wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: Iɣerdayen wezzilen ddeqs-nsen akken ad kecmen deg yiwen n uberru ɣezzifen 1 n lmitrat ( yerna qrib am yiwen deg tehri).
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Iɣerdayen zemren ad rren ddehn-nsen akken ad walin akken ilaq war ma ḥwaǧen taɣbalut n tafat.
Iɣerdayen d wid yettwassnen s tissit-nsen iǧehden i izemren ad d-yeǧǧ ḥedd ad yeɣli s snat n tikkal ɣef teɣzi-nsen. Rmed akken ad teččeḍ cwiṭ u ad d-terreḍ akk tazmert-ik.
Imdanen ur sɛin ara asnifel ɣef wurar n lsas.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Iflisen n useklu sɛeddayen akk tudert-nsen deg usluɣmu s isennanen - tissegnatin-nsen d tid yettmettaten ugar.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: Mi ara ilin deg yifeṭṭiḍen neɣ deg yiferrawen d imeqranen, ifelmen n yisekla zemren ad zzin akken ad walin deg yiḍ, dɣa ur ten-ttwali ara lɣaci i ten-yezzin.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Ilfen n useklu zemren ad ḍefren acengu kra n wakud seld ma ḍurren-t, ɣas ma ur t-ttwalin ara.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: Seld ad d-terreḍ kra n tesdidin, serreḥ-as i tceqquft s tɣawla d tseddi i wakken ad tafeg ugar, ad tεeddiḍ gar sin n yeεdawen.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: Iflisen n useklu ur sɛin ara aṭas n tezmert, yerna rennun s ttawil imi ttlusuyen iserdasen ẓẓayen (Ayagi yezmer ad yettuseḥbes s useḥḥar).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Iflisen n teẓgi ttidiren deg teẓgi yerna deg umtawa - ur zmiren ara ad ččen aksum.
Iflisen n useklu ɣezzifen cwiṭ ɣef umdan.
Iflisen n useklu ur sɛin ara tazmert meqqren, maca d arurad. Inzaḍ-ik ur d-ttḍurrun ara aṭas, maca d arurad acemma.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Allure
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: Ifawen d wid yessewhamen s wudem agaman. Iɣewwaṛen ad ten-ḍefṛen seg waṭas n lebɛid ɣef akken ara ten-ḍefṛen i yiɣersiwen nniḍen.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: Ifawen wezzilen ddeqs-nsen, ɣas ini ur ɣezzifen ara ɣef ugublin.
Aẓru d lfeṭṭa ḥebsen tazmert n yifawen. D awezɣi fell-asen ad tt-lsen.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Ifawen d iɣersiwen fessusen, yesɛan afriwen, i izemren ad εeffsen deg yigenni s ttawil.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Seqdec tazmert n tudert i kra n wakud wezzilen. Mi ara tiliḍ d urmid, zzerz irden deg wakal n tferka, tbeqqeḍ-d tazmert n useḥlu akked usizdeg i yimeddukal iqerben.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Ssemɣareḍ-d tazmert n tudert i d-yettawin tibexsisin deg temnaḍt i k-d-yezzin.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: Mi ara tiliḍ deg iɣallen n teẓgi, rennun leǧruḥ-ik s tɣawla.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: Teqqneḍ ɣer ugama, i ak-d-yefkan tazmert mgal ssem d tnezzut, d useḥbiber mgal iɣerra-nni n ssḥur.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Ifawen d iɣersiwen iḥerfiyen ur nesɛi ara tazmert am tin n wemdan.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: Igublin d iɣersiwen imegziyen, yerna ẓran anida ara d-afen lfayda ur nettwassen ara maḍi.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: D arurad
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Ɣef sebba n teɣzi-nsen tamecṭuḥt, igublin ur sɛin ara aṭas n tezmert yerna zgan ttwaɣayen.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: Aẓawali
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: Iɣewwaṛen sɛan assaɣ uslig akked agerruj - ttaɣen-d tibunusin-nniḍen mi ara sqedcen neɣ ad lsen iferdisen n wureɣ.
Uṛeɣ deg yifassen n uɛekkaz yettdum ugar n waṭas n wiyaḍ ur nettḥadar ara yes-s.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: Nimble
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: Ulamma wezzilen, igublin d arurad aṭas, ayen i ten-yeǧǧan ad rewlen ɣef tuget n yeεdawen iǧehden ugar deg umḍiq n umennuɣ.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: Igublin wezzilen aṭas, ur ɣezzifen ara azgen seg teɣzi n umdan.
Gorgons ur zmirent ara ad ṣebbrent taḥeqqit n waman u ad ḍurrent seg-sen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Gorgons llan ttwaḥekmen ad qqimen ttwaḥeṣlen deg yifriwen iberkanen d yiḥder iqburen. Ma yella deg beṛṛa deg uzal, ad ten-yeǧǧ ad uɣalen d iẓra armi d iḍ. Tzemreḍ ad ten-tekkseḍ ma telsiḍ amḍelliw.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: Gorgun ur zmirent ara ad tt-lsent neɣ ad tt-ṭṭfent. (Aẓru yettwaḥsab daɣen d uẓref)
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: Mmel-d allen n yal agraw i k-d-yettmuqulen, err-iten d ablaḍ i kra n wakud. Ur iteddu ara ɣef yimasayen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: Gorgons ur ten-yettawi ara ssem, dɣa sɛant tagnit ad zzin idammen-nsent ssem ɣef iɛdawen iqerben mi ara ten-wten, ad ten-ssemsen.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Gorgons ttarran-d ccedda meqqren s wazal-is deg tezmert meẓẓiyen.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: Ilfen imeqranen ttεeṭṭilen imi ttlusuyen iɣallen ẓẓayen (Ayagi yezmer ad yettwaseḥbes s useḥḥar), yerna ur sɛin ara aṭas tazmert.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: S tuṭṭfa n yiferdisen yemgaraden, ifelmen imeqranen zemren ad snernin tazmert n tɣawsa akken ad d-ssuffɣen kra n tẓuriyin yemgaraden. Sɛeddi taqeffalt n usnirem ɣef yal tankult akken ad twaliḍ talqayt.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: Alfu ameqqran ur yettwaxleq ara i umennuɣ s ufus ɣer ufus. D wid yettwaḥerṣen s waṭas s tfekka, ur sɛin ara aṭas tazmert.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: Ilfen imeqranen d wid yesɛan tazmert yerna ḥeṛcen deg useqdec n tnezmart tusligt - d nutni i d-yettḍurrun ugar n lmeḥna yerna ur d-ttḍurrun ara aṭas n lmeḥna ɣef temɣiwin-nniḍen.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_rpgm: Ilfen imeqranen s wudem agaman sɛan ugar n mana ɣef temɣiwin-nniḍen, yerna zemren ad sbedden tazmert n yimɣaren-nsen akken ad d-snulfun mana s tɣawla.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: Ilfen imeqranen s wudem agaman sɛan ugar n mana ɣef temɣiwin-nniḍen, yerna zemren ad sbedden tazmert n yimɣaren-nsen akken ad d-snulfun mana s tɣawla.
Ilfen imeqranen s wudem agaman sɛan ugar n mana ɣef temɣiwin-nniḍen, yerna zemren ad sbedden tazmert n yimɣaren-nsen akken ad d-snulfun mana s tɣawla.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: Ilfen imeqranen s wudem agaman sɛan ugar n mana ɣef temɣiwin-nniḍen, yerna zemren ad sbedden tazmert n yimɣaren-nsen akken ad d-snulfun mana s tɣawla.
Ilelliyen imeqranen d iẓidanen yerna ɣezzifen cwiṭ ɣef umdan alemmas.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.crazed.de: Akken bɣun ɛerḍen, Ilelliyen n wayyur ur zmiren ara ad ṭṭsen deg umaḍal.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: Deg tillas, Ilelliyen n wayyur zemren ad uɣalen d wid ur nettban s tuffra, u ad ttḥerriken ɣef cwiṭ n teɣzi. Mi ara d-ṭṭfen s tuffra, azbu-nsen amezwaru ad d-yeglu s lexṣara n uzegrir u ad yekfu tifin-nsen. Ayagi ad d-yeglu s lexṣara-nniḍen ma yella ḥekmen s lmus.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Ilelliyen n wayyur ttεeṭṭilen imi ttlusuyen iɣallen ẓẓayen. Aya yezmer ad yettwaseḥbes s usḥerci.
Iflisen n wayyur d izuranen rnu d wid yettfeǧǧiǧen cwiṭ, yerna aglim-nsen yesɛa tiɣmi tamidadit.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Ilelliyen n wayyur rẓan tazmert-nsen, rennun deg leǧruḥ-nsen.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: Ilelliyen n wayyur d wid ifazen maḍi deg useqdec n yimrigen fessusen yerna fessusen i tuffra. Ttḍurrun ugar s lmus d lmus.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: S tmuɣli-nsen taruradt, Ilelliyen n wayyur sɛan cwiṭ n tegnit akken ad rewlen i yal aεekkaz.
Ilfen n wayyur sɛan azal am wid n watmaten-nsen ibeɛden n teẓgi, ayen i ten-yesseɣlayen cwiṭ ɣef yemdanen.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: Iɣerdayen meqqrit, ur zmiren ara ad ɛeddin deg tewwura neɣ ula deg waṭas n yiɣewwaren imecṭaḥ.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: Iɣerdayen ur d-cliɛen ara maḍi deg ayen tetten. učči d učči. Ur ttḥulfun ara i ssem neɣ i laẓ.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.name: Rawenus
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.desc: Iɣerdayen ɣas ini werǧin ččuren; ḥwaǧen ad ččen yal ass akken ad qqimen ččuren.'
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.name: Aswaɣi
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.descr: Iɣil yettḥulfu i yiman-is deg ufus n uɛeggun; lfeṛḥ-a i sen-yettaǧǧan ad zzin s waṭas n lǧehd.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: Yettwassen-d d akken izamaren ttafgen s wudem ur netturaju, anda zemren ad zzin s uḍar deg terbaɛt n yeεdawen s tɣawla, maca ɣas ini ur zmiren ara ad d-afen ayen iḍerrun i ten-yezzin.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: D arurad
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: Iɣerdayen ẓẓayiten ɣef wiyaḍ, akken ad ḥerzen kra n tezmert-nsen ɣas akken meqqren aṭas.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: Stocky
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: Aglim-nsen azuran d yiɣsan-nsen imeqranen, d ayen i ten-yettaǧǧan zemren ad d-ṭṭfen ugar n wiyaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: Ipixies ur zmiren ara ad lsen tiqejjirin meqqren ugar n uglim, yerna ur zmiren ara ad sqedcen afriwen-nniḍen akken ad afgen akken nniḍen.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: Tipixiyin fessusent aṭas, ulamek ara ɣlint.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: Ɣef uḍebsi
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Tipixiyin zemrent ad tafgent, ad zzin ɣer sdat neɣ d asawen.
Ɣeṛ tibwaḍin ɣer tama n tnezmart-a i yinelmaden ɣef wamek ara tferfeḍ.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: Anegzum
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: Tzemreḍ ad teqqimeḍ ɣef uqerru n umyurar-nniḍen s usiti ayeffus s yifassen ilmawen.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: Xas akken pixies zemren ad d-awin uguren, ttemcabin-d daɣen d ẓẓher. Mi ara d-tettwaɣra, tikwal ad d-awint kra n tɣawsa s wazal-is seg ublaḍ.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: Tipixiyin d kra seg iɣersiwen imecṭaḥ akk i yettmerriḥen deg wakal, d tixeṭṭay i ttawḍent ula ɣer tgecrirt n umdan.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: Yeččur d aman
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: Akken meẓẓiyit i llan, aman d ayen i d-yettawin ugur meqqren i yipixiyen. D ayen i ten-yessewḥalen deg uḥerrek-nsen, yerna ur zmiren ara ad afgen.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: Imezdaɣ n taddart ssnen ifikiyen s tmucuha i d-ssewwayen, dɣa ugin ad zzenzen yid-sen.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: Iɛeggunen d ayen yessexlaɛen. Imezdaɣ n taddart ugin ad zzenzen yid-sen seg tugdi.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: Taḥṛict yessexlaɛen tečča-d tacriḥt-nni, tečča-d s ttawil tudert n kra n win yettidiren deg leǧwayeh-is.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: Ur zmiren ara ad ṭṭsen wid yettwaɛebban, acku ḥeznen aṭas.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: Xas akken leqriḥ-nni ameqqran werǧin ad ifakk, aṭas n yiɣes i izemren ad yemmten. Wid i t-yettawin ur ten-yettawi usemmiḍ neɣ ur ten-yettɣimi.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: Yal 5 n ddqayeq, mi ara mmten, wid yettwaɛebban ttwarran s tmara akken ad rnun ad ddren akken ad rnun ad ḥeznen.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: Yal mi ara d-teṭṭfeḍ, yezmer ad d-yeffeɣ waṭṭan.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: Wid yettwaḍurren, d wid yeččuren d tiḥdayin, d wid yettḥerriken, d wid yettqerriḥen. Wid yettwaḍurren, ur zmiren ara ad lsen iserdasen ɣef lǧal n leqriḥ-nni i d-yettawi.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: Aṭṭan-a yessewway tarwiḥt, d ayen ara d-yeǧǧen tazmert d tɣawla.
power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: Deg waman, isirinen zemren ad snuffsen u ad mmeslayen akken iwata, ad walin akken ilaq, yerna ad ɛummen s tɣawla tameqqrant.
power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: Isirinen d tmes ur ttemxalafent ara. Yal asnerni d tmes ad d-yeglu s tmettant deg teswiɛt.
power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: Tisirinin sɛant lǧeṛṛa i d-yettuɣalen s tɣawla ugar, maca ɣas ma llant deg waman.
power.medievalorigins.siren.out_of_your_: Mi ara llint deg wakal, Tisirinin zemrent kan ad ḥellunt neɣ ad d-nnernent s useqdec n tenfalin.
power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Rmed-it akken ad tkecmeḍ ɣef yeεdawen deg yiwet n temnaḍt meqqren, akken ur k-ttḍurrun ara kra n wakud. Ur iteddu ara ɣef yimsulta neɣ imuraren.
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.name: Yessewham
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.descr: Tekki ɣef tqeffalt tamirant tis snat akken ad tesɛuḍ aḥbib ɣer yimdanen n taddart u ad d-remseḍ tiɣawsiwin yelhan sɣur-sen.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Yitiyen zemren ad ttwaɣen s tmes acku d tagrest i llan.
Yeti yezmer ad yemḍel aɛdawen-is deg ugris ma yefka-d taladna. Ur iteddu ara deg lqaɛa neɣ ɣef yimḍebbren.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.from_whence_y: Deg yibiyumen n ugris, yetis ttḥerriken s tɣawla yerna ur d-ttḍurrun ara mi ara ɣlin.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.frosty_breath: Aɛebbuḍ-nni asemmaḍ n yiṭiti yesseḥbibir akk imcewwlen i d-yettqerriben ɣur-s.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.thick_fur.des: Di tneẓrufin, taferkiḍt tameqqrant teqqel d lxiṛ - tesseḥbibir tikli n yititen yerna tesseḥbibir ɣef tezmert-nsen
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.name: Tayitank
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.descr: Yitiyen sɛan aṭas n tezmert ugar n umdan amagnu.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.unstoppable.d: Yitiyen ur ten-tettḍurru ara tuffɣa n leɛqel.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.winter_body.d: Yitiyen ɣezzifen cwiṭ ɣef umdan n tannumi, yerna meqqrit aṭas.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.command_s: Mudd-as i yimdanen-ik ur nemmut ara (maci i iɛudiwen) ad k-ḍefren, ad qqimen, neɣ ad k-id-awin s tiliɣri.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.black_thu: Win i d-yuɣalen ur yezmir ad d-yejmeɛ akk lɣella-s, ad teqqur s ufus-is.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.disturbed: Aɛraḍ deg wayen yettwagedlen yessewḥel allaɣ. Wid i d-yettuɣalen ur zmiren ara ad ṭṭsen, ugaden ad urgun ayen ur ẓrin.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: Ma yebɣa, win i d-yuɣalen yezmer ad d-yernu tawinest n yiɣeskan ur nemɛin ara, ad ilin d aḥuddu askudan akken ad ten-yeḥrez seg umihi neɣ ad ten-ijerreḥ ɣef yeεdawen iqerben.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unwithera: Wid i d-yettuɣalen d wid ur nettmettat, yerna am wid ur nemmut, ttaɣen-d ugar n lexṣara s uḍellaɛ, ttaɣen-d isefra i d-yettuɣalen seg wayen i d-yettḍurrun d wayen i d-yesseḥlayen, yerna ur ttaɣen ara ssem d wayen i d-yettuɣalen.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.putrid_co:
S tigawt-nni yessewhamen n wučči n uksum neɣ iɣsan n wid ur nemmut ara, win i d-yuɣalen yezmer ad d-yefk tazmert i tuɣalin-is i d-iteddun.. 
I yiɣersiwen n umennuɣ, simɣur akud-nsen, err-iten d imezgiyen s tezmert tafellayt. I yiɛudiwen ur nemmut ara, snerni imyerren-nsen s tezmert tafellayt.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.skeleton_: Wid i d-yettuɣalen zemren ad d-snulfun iɣersiwen n yiḍ i yettwabeddlen akken ad xedmen ayen i sen-yehwa. Wigi ttarran iman-nsen d iɣersiwen, ad ten-ḍefren, ad ten-id-ttawin s tiliɣri, yerna zemren ad sɛun imrigen neɣ tiserdasin. Izzumyen ur zmiren ara ad sqedcen taẓeyt. Sɛeddi tanaka n usebrureq i wugar n telqayt.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.poor_repu: Imezdaɣ n taddart ur bɣin ara ad znuzun d wid i d-yettuɣalen, dɣa ad ten-id-ṭṭfen yigulmen n wuzzal akken kan ara ten-walin. D acu kan, ttwaqeblen-ten (s cwiṭ kan) sɣur imakaren.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon.de: Mi ara ten-yewwet yiwen, wid i d-yettuɣalen ttaɣen-d cwiṭ cwiṭ kra n tezmert i ten-yettaǧǧan ad kksen tudert i yeɛdawen-nsen. Ayagi yettḥaz akk iɣersiwen, ama deg lxir neɣ deg cceṛ, anagar wid i d-yettwaɛerḍen d wid yemmuten.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unguarded: Aḥerrek n tgelda n yinesnasen yeǧǧa inebgawen d wid yeldin ugar i unekcum deg tgelda n tfekka. Tuget n terbaɛin ttḍurrun-asen ugar.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.wings.des: Valkyrie ɣur-s iferrawen d imeqranen d imellalen, dɣa yezmer ad yafeg s tlelli.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.intervent:
Neggez d asawen deg yigenni neɣ zzi ɣer sdat ma yella tettafgeḍ yakan, ad tesɛuḍ tamagit mgal tuɣalin alamma teɣliḍ. 

Mi ara d-terseḍ neɣ seld 10 n tasinin, ḍeqqer tamnaḍt-nni s tnezmart tamqrant, s usizdeg n yir igmaḍ seg yimdukkal iqerben sakin seḥlu-ten, rnu zzi-d wid ur nelli ara d imdukkal. Seḥlu tifesniwin s tezmert n usseḥlu.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.divine_sm: Yal asarag wis kraḍ, kkat ɣef yeɛdawen iqerben. Lmeḥna n lexṣara s tezmert n usseḥḥer.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.corruptio: Iɣerdayen n wid ur nemmut ara i d-yezgan ɣer tama-k ad k-rren d afessas, ad k-rren d aweɛṛan, rnan ad k-d-sḍurren ugar.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.vanquishe: Mi ara tenɣeḍ agraw n wid ur nemmut ara, sekker §nDivine Smite§r§r§r u ad nesneqseḍ cwiṭ igmaḍ n §nTawaɣit§r i yal win yettwanɣan. Sruḥ azgen n tkerrust deg tmettant.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.heavenly_: Valkyrie ɣur-s s wudem agaman ugar n tezmert n usseḥḥu, yerna iǧehden ugar s yiẓekwan neɣ imrigen yecban ajenwi.
enchantment.medievalorigins.featherweigh: Aḥeckul-a yezmer ad yettwasnes ɣef yiɣallen ẓẓayen akken ur d-yettruẓu ara tazzla n Arachnae, Elves, Alfiq, neɣ wid yesɛan afriwen.
enchantment.medievalorigins.mirroring.de: S ssḥur-a yettwasnasen ɣef yiselmusen, imuraren ur d-ttnadin ara seg tmuɣli-nni n Gorgon, dɣa imecṭaḥ ttwalin s wudem amagnu deg tafat n wass.
badges.medievalorigins.pixie.jump:

 §bFP§r yettnerni kan mi ara yili deg lqaɛa.

Ma yella §bFP§r ad ifakk akk, ad tḥebseḍ aḥewwes.

badges.medievalorigins.pixie.dash_upward:

Aya yesseqdac daɣen 50 §bFP§r ma yella yettferfir, akked 25 §bFP§r ma ulac.

badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.glacial_: §bGlacial Step:§r Ṭṭef aḥric n wegris akken ad tesferkeḍ entropi n temẓin n waman, ad k-yeǧǧ ad tedduḍ am akken tesɛiḍ Icewalker

badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.instant_: §eSeḥlu s wudem amiran:§r Sit s tqeffalt tayeffust ɣef umdan n taddart s tteffaḥt n wureɣ akken ad tesseɣtiḍ srid tazmert-is n teḥlujit war ma tesseḥsifeḍ-t
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.void_war: §5Void Warp:§r Sit ɣef %s mi ara teṭṭfeḍ tamart Ender akken ad tcerḍeḍ s uceṭṭiḍ n tilawt u ad tbeqqeḍ iman-ik srid ɣer wanda tettwaliḍ, alamma d 50 n yiḥedran
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.blazenbr: §cBlazenbreath:§r Sit ɣef %s skud teṭṭfeḍ ajeḥniḍ deg snat n yifassen-ik akken ad d-tessufɣeḍ akermus n tmes. Ṭṭef aferdis n tmes deg umḍiq-is akken ad d-tessufɣeḍ akermus n tmes. Tifesniwin s tezmert Fire Spell.
badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbrea: §dEbonbreath:§r Tekki ɣef %s akken ad teṭṭfeḍ nnefs n uzrem deg tqerεet deg snat n yifassen-ik akken ad d-tessufɣeḍ taḥnaccaḍt n tmes taḥṛict iǧehden. Tifesniwin s tzemmar n tmes akked tzemmar n usekḥer.
badges.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon: Ṭṭef amdan akken ad t-tekkseḍ seg lǧehd-is n tudert. Kkes-d lmeḥna s useqdec n teɣbalut d tezmert n usihel n terwiḥt.
badges.medievalorigins.revenant.eat: Ɣer tama n yiɣsan d uksum yeqquren, ma teččiḍ iqerra n kra n yiɣersiwen, yezmer ad d-yerr s tɣawla taɣbalut-a.
